subject: general
question: Under which initiative was the new common logo for all Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) unveiled?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One RRB One Logo initiative.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **NABARD and the Government of India unveiled a new common logo for all Regional Rural Banks.**
 
• **The move aims to establish a single and unified brand identity for RRBs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The logo was launched under the One RRB One Logo initiative.**
 
• **It follows the principle of One State One RRB.**
 
• **The logo symbolises progress, nurturing and enlightenment.**
 
• **All 28 RRBs will now use the same unified logo.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **RRBs**__ – Regional Rural Banks provide banking and credit services in rural and semi-urban areas.
 
• The new logo includes an upward arrow for progress, hands for nurturing, and a flame for enlightenment.
 
• Deep blue colour represents finance and trust, while green signifies growth and rural development.
 
• RRBs currently operate over 22,000 branches across more than 700 districts in India.
